dataset.name: EuroSAT RGB
dataset.normalization: scale uint8 to [0, 1], bilinear resize, ImageNet mean/std

backbone.name: ResNet-18 SeCo (Sentinel-2 RGB)
backbone.pretraining: Seasonal Contrast on Sentinel-2 RGB (Manas et al., ICCV 2021)
backbone.foundation_model_note: SeCo ResNet-18 is a self-supervised Sentinel-2 encoder with 11M parameters. It is not a transformer foundation model. Prithvi, SatMAE, DOFA, and Clay are not downloaded here.

adaptation.lora_targets: ResNet-18 layer4 conv1 and conv2 (3x3). Downsample 1x1 stays frozen.
adaptation.linear_probe: Frozen backbone, BatchNorm eval, trained fc only, on cached embeddings.
adaptation.full_finetune: All weights trainable, BatchNorm in train mode.
adaptation.selection: best validation macro-F1; ties keep the earlier epoch
adaptation.epoch_budget_note: Linear probe epochs are a cap on the classification head only. LoRA and full finetune use the base epoch cap, extended so each run gets at least 40 optimizer steps when the subset is small.

protocol.std: sample standard deviation, divisor n-1; null when n_seeds < 2
notes: Label fractions are fractions of the fixed CPU pool, not of all 16,200 spatial-train chips.
Within a seed, the 1% subset is a prefix of the 10% subset, which is a prefix of the 100% subset.
The pool, validation slice, and test slice are drawn once and do not depend on the training seed.
The spatial test band is not used to choose epochs, learning rates, or the backbone.
The validation slice is class-balanced. The spatial test band keeps its natural class counts.
No geometric augmentation. The comparison is the adaptation rule, not a flip policy.
LoRA and full finetune use at least 40 optimizer steps. The 2,000-image run stays at 8 epochs.

spatial_train_majority.rule: most frequent class in the full spatial train split; ties break to the smaller class index
